text:

I am currently at the University of New Hampshire, pursuing my Master’s degree in Marine Biology with Dr. Ashley Bulseco.
I graduated from Northeastern University (Spring 2025) with a Bachelor’s of Science in Environmental and Sustainability sciences with a concentration of Earth, Oceans, and Environmental Change.
